facts.fact: Camtel's Zamengoé data centre is certified Tier III by the Uptime Institute and hosts more than a hundred public and private bodies, by Camtel's account.
The Zamengoé data centre is operated by Camtel, Cameroon Telecommunications, and described by its director general as an exclusively Cameroonian foundation for public data.
More than a hundred public and private administrations host their data at the Camtel Zamengoé data centre, which the article presents as serving government action.
